title: Looks equal, stays different
objective: Find two distinct strings with the same UTS #39 confusable skeleton but different NFC forms.
graphDescription: Pinned UTS #39 mappings produce a security-oriented skeleton for each input.
hints: Confusable characters are not necessarily normalization-equivalent.
Explore visual confusables for the Latin letter a.
Compare Latin a with Cyrillic а (U+0430).
explanation: UTS #39 skeletons flag text that may be visually confusable. The relationship is a security signal, not canonical equivalence, semantic equality, or a guarantee for every font.
